title: Aromatic Irish Potato Curry
description: A light, sour Irish potato curry made with a bhuna base and whipping cream, perfect for meal-prep.

ingredients.name: Seasoning
ingredients.amount: 1 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon black pepper

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat until shimmering.
Add the diced onion, minced garlic, and minced ginger, sautéing until the onion turns translucent.
Stir in the curry powder, turmeric, and cumin, cooking for 1–2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the tomato paste and cook, stirring, until it darkens slightly and releases a rich aroma.
Pour in the canned diced tomatoes with their juice, stirring to combine, then bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Add the diced potatoes, cover the skillet, and let the curry simmer for about 15 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Once the potatoes are cooked, stir in the whipping cream, allowing it to thicken the sauce slightly.
Season the curry with salt and pepper, tasting and adjusting as desired.
Remove the skillet from the heat and let the curry rest for 5 minutes before serving or storing.
Portion the curry into meal‑prep containers and refrigerate; reheat gently in a saucepan or microwave before serving.
